name: Glute Bridge

instructions.description: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat, and arms resting by your sides.
Gently brace your core and flatten your lower ribs so the pelvis stays controlled.
Press through your heels and lift your hips until your shoulders, hips, and knees form a straight line.
Pause briefly, then lower your hips slowly back to the mat with control.

performanceMetrics.notes: Move smoothly and avoid using momentum.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Increase resistance using external load and an elevated upper back support.

commentsNotes: Avoid overarching the lower back at the top.
Exhale during the lift and inhale on the way down.
